name: Nanobiology
summary: A joint degree with Erasmus MC in Rotterdam that reads biology the way a physicist would: single-molecule mechanics, imaging, and the quantitative modelling of living systems, split between the two cities. It asks for more IB science than anything else in this catalogue — Mathematics AA HL, Physics HL, Biology HL and Chemistry SL — which is close to the limit of what a Diploma can carry.

notes: Nanobiology is run jointly by TU Delft and Erasmus MC and teaching is split between Delft and Rotterdam. The place recorded here is Delft, which is where enrolment and admission sit; the Rotterdam half is not represented in the place field because the model holds one place per Opportunity.
